local_threats.name: Business Email Compromise (BEC)
local_threats.description: Attackers impersonate directors or suppliers and request urgent payments or changes to bank details. Extremely common in Kenya.
local_threats.impact: Direct financial loss, often KES 100,000 – several million

local_threats.name: Mobile Money & SIM-Swap Fraud
local_threats.description: Fraudsters take over M-Pesa or bank-linked numbers through social engineering or SIM swaps.
local_threats.impact: Immediate loss of funds and account takeover

local_threats.name: Ransomware Targeting SMEs
local_threats.description: Increasingly targeting Kenyan SMEs and schools. Files are encrypted and a ransom demanded in crypto.
local_threats.impact: Business downtime, data loss, possible regulatory issues

local_threats.name: Sophisticated Phishing & Fake Invoices
local_threats.description: Highly targeted emails and WhatsApp messages impersonating banks, KRA, suppliers or internal staff.
local_threats.impact: Credential theft, malware installation, financial fraud

local_threats.name: Insider Threats & Privileged Access Abuse
local_threats.description: Disgruntled or careless staff misusing access, or former employees retaining credentials.

case_studies.title: Kisumu SME – Ransomware Recovery
case_studies.challenge: Ransomware encrypted critical accounting and inventory systems overnight.
case_studies.solution: Rapid incident response + restored from clean backups + deployed XDR and 24/7 monitoring.
case_studies.outcome: Full recovery within 18 hours. No ransom paid. Ongoing Standard Protection package.

case_studies.title: Regional NGO – Phishing & BEC Reduction
case_studies.challenge: Multiple near-miss BEC attempts and high staff click rates on phishing emails.
case_studies.solution: Customised awareness programme + phishing simulations + email security hardening.
case_studies.outcome: Click rate dropped from 28% to under 4% in 90 days. Zero successful BEC incidents since.

case_studies.title: Growing Professional Services Firm – Zero-Trust Rollout
case_studies.challenge: Remote staff accessing sensitive client data over insecure connections.
case_studies.solution: Phased Zero-Trust architecture, MFA everywhere, secure remote access, and managed endpoints.
case_studies.outcome: Secure hybrid working model with full visibility and reduced risk of data exposure.

faq.q: How quickly do you respond to critical incidents?
faq.a: Critical security incidents are prioritised with a target response under 15 minutes during monitored hours. Our Standard and Premium packages include 24/7 SOC coverage.

faq.q: Do you support on-site visits in Kisumu?
faq.a: Yes. We provide on-site support across Kisumu and surrounding areas for hardware, network, and complex issues that cannot be resolved remotely.

faq.q: Can we start with a free consultation?
faq.a: Absolutely. We offer a free initial consultation to understand your environment and recommend the most practical next steps — with no obligation.

faq.q: Do you work with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace?
faq.a: Yes. We specialise in hardening both platforms, implementing MFA, secure collaboration, and continuous monitoring.

faq.q: What is the difference between Basic, Standard and Premium?
faq.a: Basic gives foundational protection. Standard adds 24/7 monitoring and priority support (most popular). Premium adds penetration testing, dedicated support and an incident response retainer.
We accept Lipa na M-Pesa and bank transfer. Monthly billing is available for all packages.

faq.q: Is the chatbot a real person?
faq.a: I am Asha, an AI specialist trained on Infinite Cyberspace Hub’s knowledge and local Kenyan threat landscape. For complex or urgent matters I will guide you to our human team via WhatsApp.
